products.name: Calm Gel Cleanser
products.short: A low-foam gel cleanser that removes sunscreen and sweat without that tight feeling.
desc: Our everyday cleanser for humid days. The soft gel lifts away sunscreen, oil and city dust, then rinses clean — skin feels fresh, not stripped.
Use morning and night on damp skin. Massage for 30 seconds, rinse with lukewarm water.

products.name: Balance Toner
products.short: A watery, alcohol-free toner that preps skin for serum.
desc: A light hydrating layer between cleanser and serum. Pat 3–4 drops into skin with your palms — no cotton pad needed.

products.name: Dew Serum
products.short: A lightweight niacinamide serum for a smoother, more even look.
desc: Our hero serum: 5% niacinamide in a fast-absorbing water serum that layers well under sunscreen and makeup.
Use 2–3 drops morning and/or night after toner. Patch test first if your skin is sensitive.

products.name: Barrier Cream
products.short: A rich-but-not-greasy cream for dry patches and air-conditioned offices.
desc: For skin that feels tight after a day in air-con. A soft cream with ceramides that sinks in without a heavy film.

products.name: Water Gel Moisturiser
products.short: Oil-free hydration that feels like nothing on hot days.
desc: A bouncy gel for oily and combination skin. Hydrates without shine and sits well under sunscreen.

products.name: Daily Sun Fluid SPF50
products.short: A thin, no-white-cast sunscreen you'll actually wear every day.
desc: The last step of every morning routine. Light fluid texture, no white cast, dries to a soft finish. Reapply every 2–3 hours outdoors.

products.name: Night Repair Oil
products.short: A few drops at night for skin that wakes up softer.
desc: A light facial oil blend to seal in your night routine. Press 2–3 drops into skin as the final step.

products.name: Clay Reset Mask
products.short: A weekly clay mask for oily T-zones.
desc: Kaolin clay mask for once or twice a week. Leave on for 8–10 minutes, rinse before it fully dries.

products.name: The Three-Step Set
products.short: Calm Gel Cleanser + Dew Serum + Daily Sun Fluid. The routine, sorted.
desc: Everything you need for a simple morning routine, at a set price.
Includes Calm Gel Cleanser 100 ml, Dew Serum 30 ml and Daily Sun Fluid SPF50 50 ml.

products.name: Travel Minis
products.short: The whole routine in carry-on sizes.
desc: Four minis that fit in a toiletry bag: cleanser, toner, serum and sunscreen. Great for trying the range.

about.title: Made for the weather we live in
about.lead: Dewlane started with a simple frustration: most skincare is made for cold, dry climates — not for 33°C and 80% humidity.
paras: So we kept it short: a cleanser that doesn't strip, a serum that layers, a sunscreen that doesn't feel like sunscreen. Every product is tested in Malaysian weather before it goes on sale.
We'd rather you buy three things you love than ten you don't use.
values: Ask us about your skin — we reply within a day.

faq: Which products should I start with?
Start with the Three-Step Set: cleanser, serum and sunscreen. Add a moisturiser if your skin feels tight after cleansing.
Is it safe for sensitive skin?
Our formulas have no added fragrance, but every skin is different — always patch test on your inner arm for 24 hours first.
